description: Read what a game started with debug_run produced: print() output and stdout/stderr lines, plus structured errors - push_error, push_warning, engine errors and runtime script errors - each with file, function, ZERO-BASED line and call stack. Returns: lines, errors, and their counts. THIS IS THE ONLY WAY to see what the game actually did; the language server reports whether code compiles, not what it printed. Output and errors are drained on each call, so successive calls return only what is new.
name: debug_output
